mapping.summary: Catch weight handling: trade in pieces, price, cost and trace by actual weight.
claims: Dual unit of measure: a handling unit plus a weight-based accounting unit per item, changeable per line
Accounting quantity and price are computed from actual net weight
Uses BC's standard price lists rather than its own pricing engine
Weigh page captures weight per lot, serial, package and pallet
Weight can be read from GS1-128 labels via AL GS1, no scale driver
Weighing and lot assignment happen in one step
Configurable weight checks at posting for sales, purchases and transfers
Posting creates weight ledger entries linked to item ledger entries
Records weight loss when a receipt is consumed with weight remaining
Covers sales, purchase, transfer, production, inventory, warehouse and journals
Bins keep the weight of goods weighed into them
Needs BC version 28.0 or later, online and on-premises
Installs several other AppLibra apps as dependencies
